attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The user-provided name of the inspection.

attributes.name: URL
attributes.description: The URL link to an external page hosted by the partner with additional details about the inspection.

attributes.name: InspectionDate
attributes.description: The date the inspection was conducted. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2025-03-25".

attributes.name: OccupancyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy or association related to the inspection. Note: OccupancyId, PropertyId, and UnitId are mutually exclusive. One of the three are required, and only one of them can be provided in the request.

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property or association related to the inspection. Note: OccupancyId, PropertyId, and UnitId are mutually exclusive. One of the three are required, and only one of them can be provided in the request.

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit or association related to the inspection. Note: OccupancyId, PropertyId, and UnitId are mutually exclusive. One of the three are required, and only one of them can be provided in the request.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier for the created inspection
